title: Finite surjective base change detects regularity of a flat ring map
statement: Let $R,\Lambda,R\prime$ be commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $u:R\to\Lambda$ be a flat ring map [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $v:R\to R\prime$ make $R\prime$ a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and assume that every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ is $v^{-1}(\mathfrak p\prime)$ for some prime ideal $\mathfrak p\prime\subset R\prime$. Give $\Lambda\otimes_RR\prime$ its tensor-product algebra structure [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and put $u\prime:R\prime\to\Lambda\otimes_RR\prime$, $r\prime\mapsto1\otimes r\prime$. If $u\prime$ is a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then $u$ is a regular ring map.

source.document: Silvio Greco, Two theorems on excellent rings, Nagoya Mathematical Journal 60 (1976), 139–149, DOI 10.1017/S0027763000017190
source.place: Proposition 1.2, printed p.140, specialized to P = geometrically regular as in Definition 1.1; used in Proposition 1.3 and Theorem 3.1. Read from the publisher PDF through its indexed mirror; local bibliographic integration requested in report.md.

proof.text: Fix a prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$ and choose $\mathfrak p'\subset R'$ contracting to it, by the surjectivity hypothesis. Write $k=\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, $L=\kappa(\mathfrak p')$, $C=\Lambda\otimes_R k$, and $D=(\Lambda\otimes_R R')\otimes_{R'}L$. These are the fibre rings of [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. The map $k\to L$ sends the class of $a/s$ to the class of $v(a)/v(s)$: if $s\notin\mathfrak p$, then $v(s)\notin\mathfrak p'$, and elements of $\mathfrak p$ map to zero in $L$. This is a unital field map, hence injective. Regularity of $u'$ says that $D$ is Noetherian and geometrically regular over $L$ by [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

source.document: Silvio Greco, Two theorems on excellent rings, Nagoya Mathematical Journal 60 (1976), 139–149, DOI 10.1017/S0027763000017190
source.place: Proposition 1.2, converse, printed p.140; Definition 1.1 with P = geometrically regular. Publisher scan read at https://scispace.com/pdf/two-theorems-on-excellent-rings-2lc74dyy3w.pdf.

proof.text: Tensor cancellation [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-cancel-base-change], with interchange of the two factors, gives an $L$-algebra isomorphism $D\simeq L\otimes_k C$. Explicitly $((a\otimes b)\otimes\ell)\mapsto \ell\bar b\otimes(a\otimes1)$, where $\bar b$ is the image of $b\in R'$ in $L$. Its inverse sends $\ell\otimes(a\otimes x)$ to $(a\otimes1)\otimes\ell\bar x$, where $\bar x$ is the image of $x\in k$ in $L$. The balancing relations over $R$, $R'$ and $k$ make these formulas well defined, and their composites fix pure tensors. Thus they also preserve multiplication and units.

proof.text: Let $K/k$ be any finite purely inseparable extension, including $K=k$. By [lem-weil-common-extension-fields], embed $L$ and $K$ into a common field $\Omega$ compatibly over $k$. Replace their images by the compositum $M=LK\subseteq\Omega$. By [lem-weil-pbc-compositum-degree-bound], $M/L$ is finite, with degree at most $[K:k]$. In particular it is finitely generated as a field extension: a finite vector-space basis generates it as a field. The maps $K\to M$ and $L\to M$ still agree on $k$.

source.place: Tag 038W, lemma-geometrically-regular-upstairs, converse common-field proof; affine ring version using Algebra Tags 0381 and 07NG.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-geometrically-regular-finitely-generated-extensions] to the Noetherian geometrically regular $L$-algebra $D$ and the finite extension $M/L$. It gives regularity, including Noetherianity, of $M\otimes_LD$. By [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-cancel-base-change] and the isomorphism of step 2 this ring is isomorphic to $E\otimes_K M$, where $E=K\otimes_k C$. On pure tensors the isomorphism is $m\otimes((a\otimes b)\otimes\ell)\mapsto(1\otimes(a\otimes1))\otimes m\bar b\ell$; the inverse is $(x\otimes(a\otimes y))\otimes m\mapsto m\bar x\bar y\otimes((a\otimes1)\otimes1)$. The displayed mutually inverse ring maps identify the regular rings without changing any field action.

source.place: Tag 038W, lemma-geometrically-regular-upstairs, converse common-field proof; affine ring version using Algebra Tags 0381 and 07NG.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-field-extension-base-change-faithfully-flat], the map $E\to E\otimes_K M$ is faithfully flat. The regularity just proved for its target descends by [lem-weil-pbc-regular-ring-faithfully-flat-descent], so $K\otimes_k C$ is regular, including Noetherianity. This holds for every finite purely inseparable $K/k$. Taking $K=k$ first gives that $C$ is Noetherian; the full family of conclusions then says that $C$ is geometrically regular over $k$ by [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

source.place: Tag 038W, lemma-geometrically-regular-upstairs, converse common-field proof; affine ring version using Algebra Tags 0381 and 07NG.

proof.text: The prime $\mathfrak p$ was arbitrary, so every fibre of $u$ is Noetherian and geometrically regular. Together with the assumed flatness of $u$, this is exactly regularity of $u$ by [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].
